start_welcome: Tether is connected. Use the buttons below or /menu for everything.
session_recovered: Tether restarted and recovered: {details}. The buttons already in this chat still work.
session_recovered_deferred: a message waiting to be sent
session_recovered_staged: a message staged and awaiting your confirmation
session_recovered_unverified_send:
Tether restarted right after sending this — couldn't verify delivery, please check the chat:

{text}
session_recovered_unverified_send_generi: Tether restarted right after sending a message — couldn't verify delivery, please check the chat.
miniapp_missing_config: Can't turn the Mini App on yet — set the ngrok token and domain first (Mini App menu → Configure ngrok), or edit config.yaml/.env directly (see SETUP.md).
ngrok_setup_title: Set your ngrok authtoken and static domain here — see SETUP.md for how to get them (free ngrok account, free static domain).
ngrok_token_prompt: Send your ngrok authtoken now as a plain message. I'll try to delete it from the chat immediately after reading it. Expires in {seconds}s if you don't send anything.
ngrok_domain_prompt: Send your ngrok static domain now (e.g. yourname.ngrok-free.app). Expires in {seconds}s if you don't send anything.
ngrok_input_timed_out: Timed out waiting for that — nothing was saved. Try again from the Mini App menu whenever you're ready.
ngrok_token_invalid: That doesn't look like a valid token (empty, contains spaces, or too long) — nothing was saved. Try again.
ngrok_token_captured: Got it ({masked}). Save this as your ngrok authtoken?
ngrok_delete_failed: ⚠️ Couldn't delete that message automatically — please delete it yourself from the chat.
ngrok_domain_invalid: That doesn't look like a valid domain — nothing was saved. Try again (e.g. yourname.ngrok-free.app, no https:// needed).
ngrok_token_saved: ✅ ngrok authtoken saved and active — no restart needed.
ngrok_token_save_failed: ❌ Couldn't verify the authtoken was actually written to .env. Check tether.log and file permissions.
miniapp_webrevoke_done: Browser link revoked — any link sent before this no longer works. Run /miniapp link to issue a new one.
help_text:
/menu - full command menu
/unlock <password> - unlock the bot (if a password is set)
/lock - re-lock the bot
/sessions - list and switch sessions
/screen <window> - screenshot a window
/files - list recent files in the active project
/file <path> - fetch one file
/model <name> - switch model
/effort <level> - switch effort
/cmd <command> - run a PowerShell command
/clear - clear the input box
/stop - stop the current generation
/kill - close terminal/emulator/Claude
/target [name] - where plain messages go (Claude, or a keypad_profiles name)
/restart - restart Claude Desktop
/launch [name] - start Claude Desktop, or a configured app
/shutdown <minutes>|cancel - shut down this PC
/status - current model, effort, temps
/language - change language
/mode - change output verbosity
/confirm on|off - toggle send confirmation
/miniapp [on|off|link|revoke] - Mini App status, turn it on/off, or a browser/home-screen link
/settings - view/edit settings
/help - this message
menu_title: What do you want to do?
model_not_configured: This target has no model_click configured, so its model picker can't be opened - add one to its keypad_profiles entry.
model_list_failed: Couldn't read the model list - the dropdown may not have opened where expected.
model_generic_unknown: '{target}' wasn't found in the dropdown. Try /model with no argument to see what's there.
effort_current_unreadable: Couldn't read the current effort level.
mode_live: 🔴 Live — stream thinking + text as it happens
staged_sent_unverified: Sent (not verified — this target has no transcript to confirm delivery against).
staged_edit_prompt: Send the new text to replace it.
staged_send_failed: Message wasn't confirmed as sent — check the window.
usage_limit_alert: 🚫 Claude usage limit appears to be hit ({streak} consecutive checks, no reply).
usage_limit_alert_continuing: 🚫 Claude usage limit hit. Reset detected around {reset_time} — will send Continue automatically {delay}s after that.
usage_limit_alert_no_reset_time: 🚫 Claude usage limit hit, but couldn't work out the reset time from the message — reporting only, won't auto-continue this time.
usage_limit_continuing: ⏰ Reset time passed — sent Continue to resume the session.
usage_limit_continue_deferred: ⏰ Reset time passed, but you're at the machine right now, so the Continue message is on hold until you're idle (same as any other remote message).
usage_limit_continue_failed: ⏰ Tried to auto-continue after the usage limit but it failed: {error}
usage_limit_resumed_on_own: ✅ Claude responded again before the scheduled auto-continue — cancelled it, nothing more to do.
shutdown_unsupported: Shutdown scheduling isn't available on this platform yet.
shutdown_confirm_prompt: Shut this PC down in {minutes} minute(s)?
shutdown_cancel_failed: Nothing to cancel — no shutdown was scheduled.
shutdown_scheduled: 🔌 Shutting down in {minutes} minute(s). /shutdown cancel to abort.
shutdown_warning: 🔌 Shutting down very soon — /shutdown cancel to abort.
files_no_project: Couldn't find an active project — no transcript with a working directory yet.
files_none_found: No matching files found in the active project.
file_not_found: Couldn't find that file, or it's outside the active project.
file_too_large: That file is larger than the {max_mb}MB limit.
unlock_not_needed: No password is set — the bot isn't locked.
unlock_locked_out: Too many wrong attempts — try again later.
target_reset: Messages now go to Claude Desktop.
dialog_click_failed: Couldn't find/click "{name}" anymore — it may have already closed.
unauthenticated_reply: This chat isn't authorized to use this bot.
keypad_title: Send a key to the app:
key_failed: Couldn't send that key - window not focused.

The app is waiting for an answer:

{text}
photo_clipboard_failed: Couldn't put the image on the clipboard.
photo_paste_failed: Photo paste didn't land — try again.
staged_photo_prompt: About to send this photo — confirm?
staged_photo_caption_prompt:
About to send this photo with:

{text}
app_started_no_window: Launched, but no window appeared yet.
launch_no_command_configured: No launch_command configured for '{name}' in config.yaml's keypad_profiles — add one to open it with /launch {name}.
app_restart_prompt:
Restart Claude Desktop? {count} processes will be closed.

This ends any session that's currently running, including this one if an agent is driving it.
app_restart_prompt_stopped: Claude Desktop isn't running. Start it?
app_restarting: Closing Claude and waiting for file handles to release...
deferred_user_active: You're using the machine right now (last input {seconds}s ago), so this is on hold rather than stealing your focus. It'll send once you've been idle a bit, or send it now:
deferred_auto_sent: You went idle - sent the held message.
app_auto_recovering: Claude died while you were away - restarting it (attempt {attempt} of {limit}).
recover_skip_user_active: Not restarting it automatically - you were using the machine, so this looks like you closed it on purpose.
recover_skip_attempt_limit_reached: Not restarting it again - it has already failed the maximum number of times in a row. Something is actually broken.
recover_skip_cooling_down: Not restarting it yet - waiting out the cooldown after the last attempt.
recover_skip_presence_unknown: Not restarting it automatically - couldn't tell whether you're at the machine.
